title: Honey 125kW / 261kWh All-in-One ESS
summary: A 125kW / 261kWh liquid-cooled all-in-one ESS cabinet for commercial energy storage and PV applications.

metrics.label: Cycles
metrics.value: 6,000 cycles @ 80% SOH (25 °C / 0.5C); up to 8,000 at cell level

specs.label: Cycle life
specs.value: 6,000 cycles @ 80% SOH (25 °C / 0.5C); up to 8,000 at cell level

faqs.question: What cooling does it use?
faqs.answer: Intelligent liquid cooling, holding cell-to-cell temperature spread within 3°C.

faqs.question: What is the cycle life?
faqs.answer: 6,000 cycles to 80% state of health at 25°C and 0.5C. The 8,000 figure is cell level only.

faqs.question: Where can it be installed?
faqs.answer: Outdoors, IP54, 1055 x 1300 x 2300 mm. Check door and delivery-route clearance before ordering.
